title: Major earthquake strikes coastal region, tsunami advisory issued
summary: A magnitude 6.8 earthquake struck offshore early Monday, prompting a tsunami advisory and evacuations of low-lying coastal towns. Officials report power outages affecting tens of thousands.

title: 6.8 quake off the coast triggers tsunami warning
summary: Seismologists recorded a strong offshore earthquake; a tsunami advisory was issued for coastal communities. Local emergency services activated shelters.

title: Port congestion worsens as dockworker talks stall
summary: Negotiations between port operators and the dockworkers union broke down, raising fears of shipping delays and downstream supply shortages heading into peak season.

title: Central bank holds rates steady amid mixed signals
summary: The central bank kept its benchmark rate unchanged, citing cooling inflation but a resilient labor market. Markets rallied modestly on the decision.

title: Open-source model release claims efficiency gains
summary: A new open-weight language model was released under a permissive license, with benchmarks suggesting strong performance at smaller parameter counts and lower inference cost.

title: New permissive-license LLM lands with benchmark wins
summary: The open-weights release drew attention for efficiency, posting competitive scores while running on commodity hardware. Community fine-tunes appeared within hours.

title: Hobbyists report long-distance contacts during band opening
summary: Amateur radio operators logged unusual long-distance HF contacts during a propagation opening tied to recent solar activity. Several shared logs and antenna setups.
